title: Frequent-Flyer Relief on the Crestline Companion Reinstatement Fee
content:
A holder of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes who flies often at a high Summit tier is relieved of part of the reinstatement fee. The relief follows the holder's current Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program together with the Crestline flight accrual entries posted to the membership in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date:

- Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman with 12 or more such flights relieves 50 percent;
- Summit Gold or Summit Platinum with 6 or more such flights relieves 25 percent;
- every other holder is relieved of nothing.

Each relief needs both its tier and its flight count.

| Current Summit tier | Crestline flight accrual entries in the last 12 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman | 12 or more | 50 percent |
| Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman | fewer than 12 | none |
| Summit Gold or Summit Platinum | 6 or more | 25 percent |
| Summit Gold or Summit Platinum | fewer than 6 | none |
| Summit Member or Summit Silver | any number | none |

**Hypothetical cases.** A Summit Chairman with 11 flight accruals receives no relief: the Summit Chairman band needs 12, and the band needing 6 is open to Summit Gold and Summit Platinum only. A Summit Gold member with 6 flight accruals receives 25 percent.
